description:
Read the stored results of an AuditAE audit — per prompt and per engine: whether the brand's URL was cited, whether the brand was named, which tracked competitor domains were cited and which competitor names were mentioned, and the cited source URLs — plus summary rates and a shareable report_url. Asks no engine.

Billing: free — reads stored results only; works at a zero balance.

When to call: to see where competitors get cited instead of the brand before paying for new checks — with list_sites' latest_audit.audit_id, or the audit_id that check_brand_citation, get_share_of_voice, get_fix_plan or get_recheck returned. Then call get_fix_plan with that audit_id.

Inputs:
  audit_id — required.
  only_lost — true for only the answered cells where the brand's URL was not cited.
  prompt — only prompts containing this text (case-insensitive).
  max_urls — cited URLs per cell, default 5 (0–50); the brand's and tracked competitors' URLs are always listed.
  include_answers — true to add answer_excerpt: about 320 chars of each answer, around the brand mention when there is one.

Returns { audit_id, brand, domain, status, created_at, engines, prompt_count, competitor_domains, visibility_score, failure_reason, report_url, charged_cents, charged_breakdown_cents: {checks, playbook}, summary: {answered, total, cited, mentioned, citation_rate, mention_rate, prompts_lost, by_engine: [{engine, answered, cited, mentioned}], competitors: [{domain, cited_cells, cited_where_brand_not}], top_cited_domains: [{domain, cells}], top_competitors_mentioned: [{name, cells}]}, results: [{prompt, engines: [{engine, status, cited, mentioned, competitors_cited, competitors_mentioned, urls, more_urls?, answer_excerpt?}]}], suggested_next?, next_step? }. A cell the engine didn't answer is {engine, status, error}. summary covers every cell; the filters only narrow results. While status is "running", results and charged_cents cover the cells answered so far; report_url is null until it's complete.

Example: { audit_id: "…", only_lost: true }

include_answers.description: true: add a ~320-char answer_excerpt per cell.

max_urls.description: Cited URLs listed per cell (default 5); the brand's and competitors' URLs are always listed.

only_lost.description: true: only answered cells where the brand's URL was not cited.

name: get_audit
title: Read an audit's per-prompt, per-engine citation results
